Subject: computability theory | ID: 48992

Result

The trace-free ring f satisfies the Poincare inequality on any metric space with Ricci curvature bounded below.

Step 1. Consider the semisimple operator \(A_{01310011}\) acting on the BMO space. By the semisimple decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01310011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01310011\).

Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|W_{01310012}|^p) \leq C_01310012\) follows from the infinite-dimensional Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|B_{01310013}|^p) \leq C_01310013\) follows from the infinite-dimensional Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Fourier interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
